newsitem.title: USA: IMC-Agrico sets additional DAP production cuts.
newsitem.headline: IMC-Agrico sets additional DAP production cuts.

text.p: IMC-Agrico Co said Friday it temporarily reduced DAP -- diammonium phosphate -- production at its central Florida operations by about 50,000 tons per month.

The company, jointly owned by IMC Global Inc AND Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP, said the scaling back is in addition to previously announced curtailments in DAP output totaling 100,000 tons per month.

"The slowdown in near-term international shipments which normally occurs at this time of the year has preceded the start of major movements in support of the domestic spring planting season," it explained.

"We remain highly optimistic about overall market demand in the coming months given the strong fundamentals that exist in the United States and other major consuming areas of the world," the venture added.
Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners is 51 percent owned by Freeport-McMoRan Inc.
